arguments.value: 68-year-old woman with metastatic lung cancer developed new-onset depersonalization and derealization temporally associated with an enlarging left posterior temporal brain metastasis (parahippocampal/occipitotemporal region). Symptoms occurred without seizure, stroke, or other psychiatric disorder and improved markedly with dexamethasone, then recurred with steroid taper as cancer progressed.
